d:
Slovenia had the reigning champions on the ropes at the FIBA U19 Basketball World Cup 2023!
USA trailed by as many as 12 points and entered the fourth quarter DOWN 11. But when the pressure was on, the Americans turned things around, outscoring Slovenia 25-11 in the final period to escape with a thrilling 77-72 win!
Slovenia came THIS close to pulling off a massive upset, but USA found a way to survive and stay unbeaten in the group stage.
Did you think Slovenia would pull off the upset?
